acceptanceCriteria: ci-shard-costs refresh retains each measured table as a dated, bounded artifact that corvint test shards --durations can read directly.
Retention is bounded (count or age) and the reader refuses a malformed table with a named code.
body: Residual from V1-1579 (PR beamfall/corvint#1027, 2026-10-17). corvint test shards takes the median of the last K retained corvint-ci-package-costs/0 tables; today those come only from the git history of package-costs.json (6 tables at the time), so K is bounded by commit history and a table cannot be retained without a commit.
title: ci-shard-costs refresh should retain dated cost tables instead of relying on package-costs.json git history (V1-1579 follow-up)
